systems.system: Blocking of pornographic websites (Council of Ministers decision of 8 July 2026)
systems.country_label: blocage des sites diffusant des contenus obscenes

note: The document reports a cabinet decision to block pornographic sites, with no timetable or mechanism and no report that any block was applied; not a cut of the internet, a social media service or a news site, and no debate, arrest or repeal is stated.
